notes: Update just the main computer: support computers on Windows update themselves to match it, when nobody is checked in and nobody has used them for 5 minutes.
Your records are protected from other phones and computers on the Wi-Fi. After updating, scan the code from Setup → Connect a device once on each tablet.
Support computers stay connected while the main computer's window is minimized, and never miss a visit.
Tablets can switch rooms: tap a room's name on the Room tab.
how: Shahien will send you the new installer. Install it on the main computer over the old one; your records stay as they are. Support computers on Windows then update themselves (install this version on them by hand once).
